kind: Stage-1 loop 10 preregistration before diagnostic/model runs

training_audit.B3: three distinct LRs, cosine 3% warmup from planned total, accumulation boundaries
training_audit.B4: vision requires_grad and labeled T4 peak memory estimate
training_audit.B5: adapter, full patch embed, unfrozen vision, optimizer, scaler, scheduler, RNG, data state, step and checkpoint size
training_audit.B6: CPU mocked continuous loss/LR/data order across resume
